headline: Judge dismisses Sam Altman's sister's sexual abuse lawsuit
summary: A US judge dismissed Ann Altman's sexual abuse lawsuit against her brother, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, after she failed to attend a required independent medical examination.

claims.statement: A US judge dismissed Ann Altman's sexual abuse lawsuit against her brother, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

sources.quote: A judge dismissed a lawsuit filed by Sam Altman’s sister against him on Tuesday.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman wins dismissal of sister's lawsuit
Judge tosses sexual abuse lawsuit from Sam Altman's sister

claims.statement: The lawsuit was dismissed after Ann Altman did not attend an independent medical examination.

sources.quote: A US district judge dismissed the case after Ann Altman had refused to attend an independent medical examination.
A lawsuit brought by the OpenAI CEO's sister was dismissed after Anne Altman refused a medical exam.

claims.statement: The judge who dismissed the case was identified as US District Judge Zachary Bluestone.

sources.quote: US District Judge Zachary Bluestone dismissed the lawsuit Ann Altman filed last year

discrepancies.explanation: Engadget's text spells the sister's name 'Anne Altman', while the other outlets' texts spell it 'Ann Altman'.
